versions.content: Verify verifyCertificateBidirectional message length check On reception of an Authentication (0x29) service with sub-function equal to verifyCer- tificateBidirectional, the Dcm shall verify that the message length fits to the size given in the parameters lengthOfCertificateClient and lengthOfChallengeClient and return a NRC 0x13 if the size does not match. The Dcm uses the lengthOfCertificateClient as offset to calculate the position of lengthOfChallengeClient.
